function choose(value: string): 'general';
function choose(value: 'yes'): 'specific';
function choose(value: string): 'general' | 'specific' { return value === 'yes' ? 'specific' : 'general'; }
function numeric(value: number): string;
function numeric(value: 1): number;
function numeric(value: number): number | string { return value === 1 ? 1 : 'other'; }
function flag(value: boolean): string;
function flag(value: false): number;
function flag(value: boolean): number | string { return value ? 'yes' : 0; }
const specific: 'specific' = choose('yes');
console.log(specific, choose('no'), numeric(1).toFixed(), flag(false).toFixed());

interface Dispatch {
  send(value: 'yes'): 'first';
  send(value: string): 'earlier';
}
interface Dispatch {
  send(value: 'yes'): 'second';
  send(value: string): 'later';
}
const dispatch: Dispatch = { send: (value: string) => value === 'yes' ? 'first' : 'later' } as any;
const first: 'first' = dispatch.send('yes');
const last: 'later' = dispatch.send('no');
console.log(first, last);

interface Callable {
  (value: string): 'earlier';
  (value: `yes`): 'first';
}
interface Callable {
  (value: string): 'later';
  (value: 'yes'): 'second';
}
const callable: Callable = ((value: string) => value === 'yes' ? 'first' : 'later') as any;
const firstCall: 'first' = callable('yes');
const lastCall: 'later' = callable('no');
console.log(firstCall, lastCall);

interface Factory {
  new (value: string): { name: 'general' };
  new (value: 'yes'): { name: 'specific' };
}
class Maker { constructor(public name: string) { name === 'yes' ? this.name = 'specific' : this.name = 'general'; } }
const Factory: Factory = Maker as any;
const made: 'specific' = new Factory('yes').name;
console.log(made);

type Alias = 'yes';
interface NonSpecialized {
  (value: string | undefined): 'first';
  (value: Alias): 'alias';
  (value: ('yes')): 'parenthesized';
  (value: 'yes' | 'no'): 'union';
  (value: `yes${number}`): 'template';
  (value: undefined): 'undefined';
}
const ordinary: NonSpecialized = (() => 'first') as any;
const alias: 'first' = ordinary('yes');
const templated: 'first' = ordinary('yes4');
const omitted: 'first' = ordinary(undefined);
console.log(alias, templated, omitted);
